system.description: By spending a number of Mental Traits relative to the size of the area encased (one for a small rodent, five for a normal-sized person), the thaumaturge solidifies air within 50 yards and line of sight into an impenetrable, opaque barrier, even resisting Potence. Mortals trapped inside suffer the discomfort of breathing liquefied air and cough up its contents (one bashing damage) once freed. This power lasts one scene. This path retests with the Occult Ability and functions upon any object within the thaumaturge's direct line of sight, though blood within a living body cannot be affected.
